title: ArchitectureEdge
description: A typed directed connection between two nodes. Evaluation-relevant edges must carry traffic_type and direction semantics.

direction.description: Flow direction semantics. Defaults to unidirectional source->target.

protocol.description: Optional protocol label (http, grpc, tcp, amqp, native...).

traffic_type.description: Semantic traffic classification used by the evaluator.

properties.description: Edge semantics: pattern (sync|async), delivery (at_most_once|at_least_once|exactly_once), ordering, throughput hints, read/write ratio.
